content: In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: it goes on.
author: Robert Frost
story:
Preserved as part of Robert Frost's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of impermanence and wisdom. Across his life and work, Robert Frost returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
